notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
New developments:

 Voice-overs: voice overs have been developed. Now you can listen to your favorite characters talk instead of just reading their conversations.


 Controller support: with the new update we added controller support so you can use your favorite controller to follow along the Blaze brothers story.

Bugs fixed:

 Stuck in Chapter 6: we fixed a bug that stopped players from progressing in the story-line in Chapter 6.


 Achievements: we fixed a bug that prevented reaching some of the steam achievements of the game.


 Game version: the game version in the main menu has been update.


 Localization: some grammar issues in the dialog have been fixed.


 Music restart: there was a bug that restarted the music every time a dialog appeared, with this fix now you can listen to the whole music track.

Extra:

 Store page: the system requirements in the steam store page have been updated to be more accurate to what systems can run our game.
